plectr.stageAria: Note lanes: tap the lanes or use the {{keys}} keys ({{ms}} ms window). Space or Esc to pause, 1 2 3 to change difficulty.

plectr.results.notCounted: This run does not count for records: too many notes skipped.

plectr.settings.title: Game settings
plectr.settings.speedHint: 1.00× is the classic Plectr speed. Notes fall at the same pace on every screen; a taller screen shows more of them.
plectr.settings.lightAutoOn: On this device automatic uses the light stage (fewer effects, smoother).
plectr.settings.lightAutoOff: Automatic switches to the light stage if a run drops below 50 fps.
plectr.settings.backdropHint: The visualizer follows the music but costs more; the light stage turns it off.
plectr.settings.keysHint: Tap a lane to assign it a key.
plectr.settings.keyCapture: Press the new key (Esc to cancel).
plectr.settings.vibrationHint: A short buzz on missed notes and combo milestones (where supported).
plectr.settings.challengeHint: The run ends if accuracy drops below 30%.
plectr.latency.hint: Tap the pad (or press a key) on every click: the latency is measured for you.
plectr.latency.failed: Test failed: at least six taps on time are needed.
plectr.reset.title: Reset Plectr records?
plectr.reset.message: This account's records and counters are deleted on every device. This cannot be undone.
